_comment: The frozen inputs of the demo. Every source the build reads from another repository is fetched at exactly this commit (ci/clone.mjs), and the page boots exactly this UI5 release (app/web.mjs). Nothing here moves on its own: there is no scheduled rebuild and no Dependabot. To refresh the demo, change these values by hand in one pull request and let build_web (unit tests + browser smoke) judge it. See AGENTS.md "Frozen inputs".
